title: FestivalPassengerTimepointData
description: Schema for historical and simulated 15-minute interval passenger counts at festival bus stops

stop_id.description: Unique identifier for transit stop (stop_a: Main Terminal, stop_b: East Bypass, stop_c: West Rail Gate)

stop_name.description: Human readable name of the bus terminal

distance_from_temple_km.description: Walking distance from the sanctum/main event gate in km

minutes_since_event_end.description: Relative minutes elapsed since the final festival event ended (can be negative before ending)

attendance_tier.description: Total expected evening departing crowd size (e.g. 40000)

scheduled_buses.description: Number of scheduled buses allocated at this stop in the baseline roster

passenger_arrivals.description: Observed or simulated passenger arrivals during this 15-minute window

is_simulated.description: Flag indicating synthetic calibration vs live telemetry
